_comment: Tier rules + display for the NFL theme. Read by the engine (points, No Huddle), the UI (names, colors) and the data pipeline (share / maxAnswers / restShare). Answers are ranked most famous first: tiers with `share` take that fraction of the list capped at `maxAnswers`; the rest is split by `restShare` (sums to 1). `distance` is where the throw lands (yards from our goal line).

tiers.name: Deep Shot
tiers.quip: Real fans only. Few throw this deep.

tiers.name: Hail Mary
tiers.quip: True obscurity. Touchdown from your own goal line.

miss.name: Incomplete
miss.quip: the clock beat you to it.

noHuddle._comment: Consecutive answers at minTier or better build a streak; the Nth answer in the streak scores multipliers[N-1] (last value repeats). A lower tier or a miss resets it.
